scripts.install:python: .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install --upgrade pip && .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run venv && npm run install:python
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "AI,BACKEND,FRONTEND" --prefix-colors "yellow,green,cyan" "npm run dev:ai" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.test:auth:docker: docker compose --profile test up -d --build --force-recreate --wait backend-test && docker compose --profile test exec -T backend-test npm run test:auth:baseline
scripts.test:s1a:docker: docker compose --profile test up -d --build --force-recreate --wait backend-test && docker compose --profile test exec -T backend-test npm run test:s1a
scripts.test:admin-rate-notifications:docker: docker compose --profile test up -d --build --force-recreate --wait backend-test && docker compose --profile test exec -T backend-test npm run test:admin-rate-notifications && npm run test:admin-notifications-ui
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose --profile tools run --rm db-migrate up
scripts.db:migrate:status: docker compose --profile tools run --rm db-migrate status
scripts.db:migrate:dry-run: docker compose --profile tools run --rm db-migrate dry-run
